sentences.en: There's a video on YouTube you might have seen.
sentences.zh: YouTube 上有个视频你可能看过。
它的播放量接近两亿次。

sentences.en: In this video, a pair of twin brothers are standing in a kitchen,
sentences.zh: 视频里，一对双胞胎兄弟站在厨房里，
正在进行一场小小的谈话。

sentences.en: These twin brothers are diaper-clad babies.
sentences.zh: 这对双胞胎兄弟是穿着尿布的婴儿。

sentences.en: Now, if this video featured 10-year-old twins or adult twins,
sentences.zh: 现在，如果视频里是 10 岁的双胞胎或成年双胞胎，

sentences.en: I guarantee you it wouldn't have gone viral.
sentences.zh: 我敢保证它绝对不会火起来。

sentences.en: What makes this video special is that we have no clue what these babies are saying.
sentences.zh: 这个视频的特别之处在于，我们根本听不懂这些婴儿在说什么。

sentences.en: To us non-babies, it sounds like gobbledygook.
sentences.zh: 对于我们这些非婴儿的人来说，听起来就像胡言乱语。

sentences.en: Here at Hidden Brain, we love trying to understand the puzzles and contradictions of human behavior.
sentences.zh: 在《Hidden Brain》，我们热衷于探索人类行为中的谜题与矛盾。

sentences.en: But we spend most of our time talking about the older members of the human race.
sentences.zh: 但我们大部分时间都在谈论人类中较年长的成员。

sentences.en: Today, we focus on the younger set.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将目光投向较年幼的群体。

sentences.en: I find babies are so impressive.
sentences.zh: 我觉得婴儿真是太令人惊叹了。

sentences.en: We can't really ask them what they're thinking.
sentences.zh: 我们无法直接问他们在想什么。

sentences.en: We have to come up with clever ways of figuring out what's going on in their little brains.
sentences.zh: 我们必须想出巧妙的方法来弄清楚他们的小脑袋瓜里在想什么。

sentences.en: We'll meet some of the researchers trying to decipher the behavior of babies.
sentences.zh: 我们将见到一些试图解读婴儿行为的研究人员。

sentences.en: Do babies understand us when we're talking to them?
sentences.zh: 当我们和婴儿说话时，他们能听懂吗？

sentences.en: And how babies communicate, even if they don't have words.
sentences.zh: 以及婴儿是如何交流的，即使他们还不会说话。

sentences.en: The Language of Babies, this week on Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 《婴儿的语言》，本周《Hidden Brain》为您呈现。

sentences.en: When Laura was in college, she spent her summer vacations back home in Sudbury, Ontario.
sentences.zh: 劳拉上大学时，暑假都会回到安大略省萨德伯里的家中。

sentences.en: Like five hours north of Toronto.
sentences.zh: 大概在多伦多以北五个小时车程的地方。

sentences.en: And she worked at the Magical Nook, a daycare center.
sentences.zh: 她在一家名为“魔法角落”的托儿所工作。

sentences.en: It was a large center that had different age groups.
sentences.zh: 那是一家规模很大的托儿所，分有不同的年龄组。

sentences.en: So there was like a baby room and a toddler room, preschoolers, school-age children.
sentences.zh: 有婴儿室、幼儿室、学龄前儿童室和学龄儿童室。
总共大概有 100 个孩子。

sentences.en: But my favorite room was the toddler room for sure.
sentences.zh: 但我最喜欢的肯定是幼儿室。

sentences.en: Laura's job was to help the teachers at the center engage with the kids and enforce the rules.
sentences.zh: 劳拉的工作是协助托儿所的老师与孩子们互动并执行规则。
音乐是一个必不可少的工具。

sentences.en: We would sing Wheels on the Bus, Old MacDonald.
sentences.zh: 我们会唱《巴士上的轮子》、《老麦克唐纳》。

sentences.en: If we didn't sing the clean-up songs of preschoolers, then I don't think anything would have ever gotten cleaned up.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不唱学龄前儿童的整理歌，我想什么东西都整理不好。

sentences.en: But as soon as we started, it seemed to be the trick to convince them that, yes, they were willing to put their toys away.
sentences.zh: 但只要我们一唱，这似乎就是让他们愿意把玩具收好的诀窍。

sentences.en: Laura regularly found herself in awe of the toddlers.
sentences.zh: 劳拉经常对这些幼儿感到敬佩。

sentences.en: One little kid who I had a good connection with, she grabbed my hand and brought me over to the little slide.
sentences.zh: 有个我相处得很好的小孩子，她抓住我的手，把我带到小滑梯旁。

sentences.en: And she really wanted to go down the slide, you could tell.
sentences.zh: 看得出来，她真的很想滑滑梯。

sentences.en: So I helped her up the little stairs, and I caught her at the bottom of the slide.
sentences.zh: 所以我扶她上了小楼梯，并在滑梯底部接住了她。

sentences.en: And all the rest of the toddlers in this playground just looked over and saw her and looked at each other
sentences.zh: 操场上剩下的所有幼儿都看了过来，看到了她，又互相看了看，

sentences.en: and then ran over to the slide and formed a cute little lineup waiting their turn for me to help them down.
sentences.zh: 然后跑向滑梯，排成了一队可爱的小队伍，等着我帮他们滑下来。

sentences.en: Laura's days at the Magical Nook are now over.
sentences.zh: 劳拉在“魔法角落”的日子现在已经结束了。

sentences.en: After graduating college, she went on to earn her Ph.D.
sentences.zh: 大学毕业后，她继续攻读了博士学位，
专业是心理学、神经科学和行为学。

sentences.en: She's now a postdoc at the University of Toronto, Mississauga, and her work focuses on early childhood development.
sentences.zh: 她现在是多伦多大学密西沙加分校的博士后，研究重点是儿童早期发展。

sentences.en: With years of knowledge now under her belt, she looks back on that moment at the slide and sees it as a form of communication.
sentences.zh: 如今，凭借多年的知识积累，她回想起滑梯上的那一幕，将其视为一种交流方式。

sentences.en: You know, in order for kids to look around and see what their peers are doing
sentences.zh: 你知道，孩子们环顾四周，观察同伴在做什么，

sentences.en: and to understand the goals that are embedded in those activities
sentences.zh: 理解这些活动中蕴含的目标，

sentences.en: and to then realize that they need to follow the social construct of lining up.
sentences.zh: 然后意识到他们需要遵循排队的社会规则。

sentences.en: It seems like a super simple thing, but there's a lot of understanding about themselves, about other people,
sentences.zh: 这看起来是一件超级简单的事情，但要实现这一点，他们需要对自身、对他人、

sentences.en: about goals and activities that they need to really completely understand in order for that to happen.
sentences.zh: 对目标和活动有非常深刻的理解。

sentences.en: Laura says actions like standing in line for the slide can be categorized as pro-social behaviors.
sentences.zh: 劳拉说，像排队滑滑梯这样的行为可以归类为亲社会行为。

sentences.en: They're actions we take to help others and to benefit the group.
sentences.zh: 这些是我们为了帮助他人和造福集体而采取的行动。

sentences.en: She decided to study what she'd seen on the playground more systematically.
sentences.zh: 她决定更系统地研究她在操场上看到的东西。

sentences.en: She invited a bunch of parents to bring their toddlers into the lab.
sentences.zh: 她邀请了一群家长带他们的幼儿来到实验室。
我们专门测试的是 14 个月大的婴儿。

sentences.en: So they're, you know, they're walking, they're not quite talking.
sentences.zh: 他们已经会走路了，但还不太会说话。

sentences.en: These 14-month-olds said bye-bye to mommy and daddy
sentences.zh: 这些 14 个月大的孩子跟爸爸妈妈说了再见，

sentences.en: and then were strapped into front-facing baby carriers worn by assistants in the study.
sentences.zh: 然后被绑在研究助理佩戴的前置式婴儿背带里。

sentences.en: The researchers turned on some music.
sentences.zh: 研究人员播放了一些音乐。

sentences.en: Usually it was twist and shout playing in the background.
sentences.zh: 背景音乐通常是《Twist and Shout》。

sentences.en: And the person carrying the baby began to bounce.
sentences.zh: 背着婴儿的人开始上下晃动。

sentences.en: It was like, so we would bounce them down on one beat and up on the other, down and up sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 就像这样，我们随着节拍一上一下地晃动他们。

sentences.en: So if you're this baby, you're strapped onto someone's cheSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你是那个婴儿，你被绑在某人的胸前。

sentences.en: Instead, you're looking in front of you at another assistant.
sentences.zh: 相反，你面对的是另一位助理。

sentences.en: The person facing the baby would either move in synchrony with how they were being bounced,
sentences.zh: 面对婴儿的那个人要么会随着晃动的节奏同步移动，

sentences.en: so they were bouncing together, or they would move either too quickly or too slowly
sentences.zh: 也就是他们一起晃动，要么会移动得太快或太慢，

sentences.en: so that their movements weren't aligned with what the baby was experiencing.
sentences.zh: 使得他们的动作与婴儿所感受到的不同步。

sentences.en: After about two and a half minutes, the bouncing stopped, and the baby was removed from the carrier.
sentences.zh: 大约两分半钟后，晃动停止，婴儿被从背带中取出。

sentences.en: And then this person who had faced them and moved either in or out of sync with them
sentences.zh: 然后，那个面对他们并与他们同步或不同步移动的人，

sentences.en: would perform some little simple social games with them.
sentences.zh: 会和他们玩一些简单的小社交游戏。

sentences.en: So she would do things like drop pictures with markers or throw paper balls in a bucket.
sentences.zh: 比如用记号笔画画，或者把纸球扔进桶里。

sentences.en: Every now and then, the assistant who had faced the baby would drop a marker or paper ball
sentences.zh: 偶尔，面对婴儿的助理会掉落一支记号笔或纸球，

sentences.en: and then pretend like the object was out of reach.
sentences.zh: 然后假装物体够不着了。

sentences.en: So she would reach pathetically for them for about 30 seconds,
sentences.zh: 她会可怜巴巴地伸手去够大约 30 秒，

sentences.en: and we looked to see what the babies did in this really weird situation
sentences.zh: 我们观察这些婴儿在这种非常奇怪的情况下会做什么，

sentences.en: where this person they just met needs help but isn't really asking for help
sentences.zh: 即这个刚认识的人需要帮助，但并没有真正开口求助，

sentences.en: and doesn't really seem to be able to achieve their goal on their own.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来靠自己无法实现目标。

sentences.en: Laura measured how many babies would pick up and hand back the objects.
sentences.zh: 劳拉统计了有多少婴儿会捡起并递回这些物体。

sentences.en: And looked at whether the babies who we bounced in sync with
sentences.zh: 并观察那些与我们同步晃动的婴儿，

sentences.en: helped at a different rate than the babies we bounced out of sync with.
sentences.zh: 与那些与我们不同步晃动的婴儿相比，帮助的频率是否不同。

sentences.en: She found that babies who felt that they were bouncing in sync with a dance partner
sentences.zh: 她发现，那些感觉到与舞伴同步晃动的婴儿，

sentences.en: were more likely to help that partner pick up an object when it was out of reach.
sentences.zh: 在舞伴够不着物体时，更有可能帮助对方捡起物体。

sentences.en: So they would help on over half of the trials if we moved in sync with them,
sentences.zh: 如果我们与他们同步移动，他们在超过一半的试验中都会提供帮助，

sentences.en: whereas if we moved out of sync with them,
sentences.zh: 而如果我们与他们不同步移动，

sentences.en: they would help on only less than a third of the trials.
sentences.zh: 他们提供帮助的次数不到三分之一。

sentences.en: You've likely experienced the same drive if you've ever moved in sync with someone else,
sentences.zh: 如果你曾经与他人同步移动过，你可能也经历过同样的驱动力，

sentences.en: maybe on a sports team in school or in marching band,
sentences.zh: 也许是在学校的运动队里，或者在行进乐队里，

sentences.en: or maybe, like Laura, as a dancer.
sentences.zh: 或者像劳拉一样，作为一名舞者。

sentences.en: Put our service to the teSt.
Tie your napkin round your neck, Cherie.
sentences.zh: 把餐巾系在脖子上，亲爱的。

sentences.en: This song was a soundtrack of Laura's last recital in high school
sentences.zh: 这首歌是劳拉高中最后一场演出时的配乐，

sentences.en: when she dressed up as Mrs. Potts for a performance of Beauty and the BeaSt.
sentences.zh: 当时她打扮成茶壶太太，表演了《美女与野兽》。

sentences.en: There were many numbers in the performance,
but in the Be Our Guest performance, everyone comes together,
sentences.zh: 但在《做我们的客人》表演中，每个人都聚在一起，

sentences.en: all the little kitchen utensils and everything,
and we do have to really synchronize at certain parts of the dance.
sentences.zh: 我们在舞蹈的某些部分确实需要真正地同步。

sentences.en: And so when you're experiencing that,
sentences.zh: 所以当你经历那种时刻时，

sentences.en: you really feel like you're part of this bigger group.
sentences.zh: 你会真正感觉到自己是这个大集体的一部分。

sentences.en: And, I mean, you're focusing on the task at hand,
sentences.zh: 我是说，你专注于手头的任务，

sentences.en: you know, doing all of these steps,
sentences.zh: 你知道，做所有这些动作，

sentences.en: but that's become quite automatic at this point,
sentences.zh: 但此时这些动作已经变得相当自动化了，

sentences.en: and instead you can really sort of feel the connection with your co-dancers,
sentences.zh: 相反，你可以真正感受到与舞伴之间的联系，

sentences.en: and you start to just ignore the audience completely
because you're part of this bigger thing.
sentences.zh: 因为你是这个宏大整体的一部分。

sentences.en: Come on and lift your glass.
You've won your own free pass.
sentences.zh: 你赢得了免费入场的机会。

sentences.en: To be our guest, if you're stressed...
sentences.zh: 如果你感到压力，就做我们的客人……

sentences.en: Laura's fellow dancers remain some of her closest friends to this day.
sentences.zh: 劳拉的舞伴们至今仍是她最亲密的朋友。

sentences.en: I'm going to be the emcee at one of their weddings in September.
sentences.zh: 九月份其中一位朋友结婚时，我将担任司仪。

sentences.en: So, yeah, we've definitely stayed very close.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我们确实一直保持着非常亲密的关系。

sentences.en: Music and dance create bonds because, as Laura says,
sentences.zh: 音乐和舞蹈创造了纽带，因为正如劳拉所说，

sentences.en: synchronous movement is a language of its own.
sentences.zh: 同步运动本身就是一种语言。

sentences.en: This unspoken language can guide behavior,
sentences.zh: 这种无声的语言可以引导行为，

sentences.en: even though many of us are not familiar with its syntax and vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们许多人并不熟悉它的语法和词汇。

sentences.en: I think music is providing a really interesting context
sentences.zh: 我认为音乐提供了一个非常有趣的背景，

sentences.en: where a lot of social cues are happening.
sentences.zh: 其中发生了很多社交暗示。

sentences.en: So when we're moving with other people,
sentences.zh: 所以当我们与他人一起移动时，

sentences.en: when we're doing familiar things and singing familiar songs,
sentences.zh: 当我们做熟悉的事情、唱熟悉的歌曲时，

sentences.en: these are actually cuing us, babies and adults,
sentences.zh: 这些实际上是在暗示我们，无论是婴儿还是成年人，

sentences.en: to think about the relationships that we have with these people.
sentences.zh: 去思考我们与这些人之间的关系。

sentences.en: We think about teaching our kids to be pro-social and to be good citizens,
sentences.zh: 我们考虑教导孩子要亲社会、要做个好公民，

sentences.en: but they're already attending to this information from a really early age.
sentences.zh: 但他们从很小的时候起就已经在关注这些信息了。

sentences.en: The toddler experiment also shows that kids who can't speak
sentences.zh: 幼儿实验也表明，那些还不会说话的孩子，

sentences.en: When a small child reaches out to pick up a marker or a paper ball,
sentences.zh: 当一个小孩子伸手去捡记号笔或纸球时，

sentences.en: I find babies are so impressive.
sentences.zh: 我觉得婴儿真是太令人惊叹了。

sentences.en: We can't really ask them what they're thinking.
sentences.zh: 我们无法直接问他们在想什么。

sentences.en: We have to come up with clever ways of figuring out
sentences.zh: 我们必须想出巧妙的方法来弄清楚，

sentences.en: what's going on in their little brains,
sentences.zh: 他们的小脑袋瓜里在想什么，
而每个人都低估了他们。

sentences.en: Music and dance aren't the only ways
sentences.zh: 音乐和舞蹈并不是成年人和幼儿之间交流的唯一方式，

sentences.en: adults and small kids communicate with one another.
sentences.zh: 还有另一种语言，听起来确实很像语言。

sentences.en: There's another language that actually sounds a lot like language.
sentences.zh: 还有另一种语言，听起来确实很像语言。

sentences.en: The traditional way of looking at babbling,
sentences.zh: 看待咿呀学语的传统方式，

sentences.en: even as recently as 15, 20 years ago,
was really that it was just motor practice,
sentences.zh: 其实都认为这仅仅是运动练习，

sentences.en: that it had no bearing on later language.
sentences.zh: 与后期的语言习得毫无关联。

sentences.en: It was just something babies did to exercise their mouths.
sentences.zh: 这只是婴儿锻炼嘴部的一种方式。
这位是瑞秋·阿尔伯特（Rachel Albert）。

sentences.en: I'm an assistant professor of psychology
at Lebanon Valley College in Anvil, Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 任教于宾夕法尼亚州安维尔的黎巴嫩谷学院。
她专门研究婴儿语言发展。

sentences.en: Those quote-unquote traditional views on babbling?
sentences.zh: 那些所谓的“传统”咿呀学语观？
他们是在表明自己要么

sentences.en: in a heightened state of arousal,

sentences.zh: 要么通过这种咿呀学语，
正在提升自己的兴奋水平，

sentences.en: and putting themselves in kind of this optimal state
sentences.zh: 让自己进入一种最佳的

sentences.en: over and above than if they were just

sentences.zh: 安静地看着某个物体要好得多。

sentences.en: Rachel says babbles have a certain je ne sais quoi.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋说，咿呀学语有一种独特的魅力。

sentences.en: When she hears a baby babble,
sentences.zh: 当她听到婴儿咿呀学语时，

sentences.en: she's taken back to high school French class.
sentences.zh: 她会想起高中的法语课。

sentences.en: And I had one of those immersive French teachers
sentences.zh: 我当时有一位沉浸式教学的法语老师，

sentences.en: who would only speak French in the classroom,
and so it was really like being dropped
sentences.zh: 所以这真的就像被扔进了一个

sentences.en: where you have to kind of figure things out.
sentences.zh: 你必须自己去摸索理解。

sentences.en: I vividly remember that she would come into the classroom,
sentences.zh: 我清楚地记得她走进教室，

sentences.en: and the whole class would kind of have blank stares of panic
sentences.zh: 全班同学都一脸茫然和恐慌，

sentences.en: and so she'd start slowing down her speech
and pointing and labeling particular objects in the room.
sentences.zh: 指着并说出教室里特定物体的名称。

sentences.en: So she would, in French, be kind of pointing and saying,
sentences.zh: 所以她会用法语指着并说，

sentences.en: you know, are you sitting in a desk?
sentences.zh: 你知道，你坐在桌子旁吗？

sentences.en: And kind of repeating those key vocabulary words
sentences.zh: 并不断重复那些关键的词汇，

sentences.en: until we started to figure out,
oh, okay, this is the word for desk.
sentences.zh: 哦，原来这就是桌子的法语单词。

sentences.en: And I thought, well, this must be somewhat similar
to what a baby experiences, right,
sentences.zh: 婴儿的经历有些相似，对吧，

sentences.en: where there's all this conversation going around.
They start to become active communication partners
sentences.zh: 他们开始成为积极的交流伙伴，

sentences.en: and trying to engage in that world,
sentences.zh: 并试图参与到那个世界中，

sentences.en: but how do they make sense of it?
sentences.zh: 但他们是如何理解这一切的呢？

sentences.en: Parents often see themselves as the know-it-all French teacher
sentences.zh: 父母通常把自己看作无所不知的法语老师，

sentences.en: and the babbling baby as the clumsy student.
sentences.zh: 而把咿呀学语的婴儿看作笨拙的学生。

sentences.en: Rachel says this framework is the one that's mostly used
sentences.zh: 瑞秋说，这种框架是目前研究
婴儿语言发展最常用的方式。

sentences.en: But the baby is playing as much of a role
sentences.zh: 但婴儿在这次互动中扮演的角色
